summary: Meera wants to be debt-free and asks what to do.
split_note: Discovery (D53): v1's traces on this task are where prompt v2's changes may come from.

messages.content: I have three loans and I want to be debt-free. What should I do?

client_sim.persona: Meera Raghavan, 34, a QA engineer in Pune who supports her son, 6, and her mother, 63. Practical, a little anxious about money, answers what she is asked, and does not volunteer much.
hidden_facts: She can put about Rs 20,000 a month in total towards her debts, minimums included
concerns: Which debt should I pay first?
client_sim.goal: Know which debt to pay first and roughly when she will be debt-free
client_sim.opening_message: I have three loans and I want to be debt-free. What should I do?

graders.description: Floor only: the card is mentioned. Whether it is recommended first is the judge's criterion.
Open coding plus yes/no criteria (D53); optional until the rubric is written and the criteria pass the trust bar (D7, D8). Its severity is the most severe of its criteria's.

criteria.text: Would a real client in this situation be well served by this? Pass or fail, and one line on why.
Does the advisor recommend paying off the 42% credit card first, before the other two loans? Yes or no.

judge_criteria_to_write: Judgment: asks for (or works out) the monthly budget before planning; avalanche order with the card first.
